verdict.rationale: MotherDuck's architecture docs list a first-party SQL IDE with notebooks, and Instant SQL previews show inline query results. Community users corroborate the Instant SQL experience. However, nothing shows Python cells inside those notebooks: Python appears only as SDKs and scheduled Flights jobs. Charts appear only through AI-generated Dives, not inline in notebooks. Missing for 10: documented Python execution within notebooks alongside SQL, inline charting in notebooks, in-depth notebook documentation.
